method: Signed-in app UI invokes its existing authenticated API

grading.internalRepairs: Allowed only under frozen production policy; every provider call is counted.
grading.pass: All requested facts, arithmetic, subjects, dates, uncertainty and format correct; no unsupported material claims.
grading.partial: A useful response with an omitted or incorrect requirement; explicit fallback loses credit if retrieved records could answer it.
grading.fail: Material wrong attribution/claim, unsupported medical certainty or mostly wrong answer.
grading.error: No answer, HTTP failure, stuck operation or failed delivery.
grading.numericTolerance: Stated exact integers; percentage rounding as expected, otherwise +/-0.02 percentage points.
grading.mutationRule: No Save, Prepare or history modifications. Conversation messages from test submission are expected.
grading.firstAttemptRule: Freeze all 15 questions and criteria before submitting any; retain errors and original grades; no code/deployment changes during run.
grading.reliabilityLimit: Targeted regression sample, not evidence of population-level 95–100% reliability.
